evidence: SwarmPayReg::Reserve keeps the first pool's outpoint and refuses that outpoint on the second pool. acc04_tests pass_latches observes the funded balances and the zero spend.
SwarmPayReg::Claim then FailCompute leaves claim_kept true and moves no atoms. acc04_tests pass_latches observes the kept claim.
SwarmPayReg::Terms refuses a later atom or timeout change and keeps the first terms. acc04_tests pass_latches observes the stored atoms and timeout.
SwarmPayReg::Settle returns UNQUALIFIED, Mode stays REGTEST_UNBROADCAST, and no atoms move. Real signed settlement is a release gate.
AcceptCanonicalEnvelope accepts one object. StrictParseJson rejects a duplicate key, so that text is not the envelope. acc04_tests pass_latches observes both results.
LeaseTable::Cancel while work is in flight returns STILL_IN_FLIGHT. ReleaseIfQuiescent then returns not quiescent. acc04_tests pass_latches observes that refusal.
One HostResourceBroker ceiling admits 60 bytes and refuses a further 50 with host budget. acc04_tests pass_latches observes the shared refusal.
UploadScheduler admits a second identity and refuses a repeat of the first with per-identity, then refuses another once slots are full. acc04_tests pass_latches observes both bounds.
SwarmTrustLabel returns the policy label and ignores a caller-supplied domain. An empty policy is TRUST_LABEL. acc04_tests pass_latches observes the accepted label.
NifScope stays on the default local policy. SendLocal keeps the payload, SendWan returns NO_ROUTE, and the packet count stays 0. acc04_tests pass_latches observes that the payload was not routed.
SwarmRecoverFault02 on an expired durable lease with a payment claim sets recovered and payment_preserved and does not commit or move bytes. acc04_tests pass_latches observes both.

SwarmCommandLog::Truncate of the commit index returns COMMITTED_PREFIX and leaves the committed command. A later truncate removes only the uncommitted tail. acc04_tests pass_latches observes the prefix. The temporary directory is removed.

SwarmProbeEngine can report a present file with advertised and qualified both false, and SwarmQualifyEngine refuses a caller-supplied rate. This process never observes an advertised capability that is not qualified, so the distinction is defined and not closed here.
MigrateSafe::Move with a higher assurance returns UPGRADE and keeps the stored assurance and body. acc04_tests pass_latches observes the unchanged record.
MigrateSafe::Fail makes Move return JOURNAL and leaves the body. After Clear, a lower claim still leaves the body and assurance. acc04_tests pass_latches observes the stored body.
The sentence requires independent real participants. hosts() stays 1 and Hosts(2) returns HOSTS. One process is not that journey.

SwarmProbeEngine on a missing file returns ENGINE_ABSENT with present, advertised, and qualified false. Gpu returns ENGINE_ABSENT. passed, gpu_passed, windows_passed, and hardware_qualified stay false. acc04_tests pass_latches observes those refusals.
SafeGitPath refuses a path that enters a git directory. Confirming research material is outside every worktree is a separate scan and is not run here.

GitObjectDigest changes when the bytes change. RefJournal refuses an empty history and publishes a ref whose record id is that digest. acc04_tests pass_latches observes the digest and the committed ref.
DocClaim refuses a qualification sentence and release_qualified stays false. Matching public documents to native behavior is a release gate and is not run here.

SwarmNoteNotTrainLicense refuses want_train with NOT_GRANT. VerifyProvenanceEvidence parses an unsigned note and leaves verified_here false. acc04_tests pass_latches observes the two checks separately.
